# 605 Home Search (605homesearch.com) – Marcos Diaz, Broker Associate, Keller Williams Realty Sioux Falls

> Bilingual (English and Spanish) real estate agent helping people buy and sell homes in
> Sioux Falls, South Dakota and nearby towns. Licensed in South Dakota. Member of the
> National Association of REALTORS®. Se habla español.

Marcos Diaz works with home buyers (including first-time buyers, veterans using VA loans,
and buyers who need down payment help, an ITIN mortgage, or are working on their credit)
and home sellers (free home value reports and seller net sheets). He serves English- and
Spanish-speaking clients and can handle the whole process in either language.

## About
- [About Marcos Diaz, client perks and FAQ](https://605homesearch.com/about/)

## Contact
- Phone/text: 605-838-9140
- Email: marcosdiaz1@kw.com
- Brokerage: Keller Williams Realty Sioux Falls, 6300 S Connie Ave, Sioux Falls, SD 57108 (office 605-275-0555)
- Website: https://605homesearch.com/ (Spanish: https://605homesearch.com/es/)

## What I help with
- Buying a home, including first-time buyers
- VA home loans for veterans and military families
- Down payment assistance, including South Dakota Housing's Give Me Five program
- ITIN mortgages and buying with low credit
- Selling a home: free home value report and seller net sheet
- Off-market home search
- Free moving trailer for clients

## Areas served
Sioux Falls (including southwest and southeast Sioux Falls), Tea, Harrisburg, Brandon,
Hartford, Crooks, Garretson, Lennox, and Canton, South Dakota.
